metadata.re_freeze_reason: The 2026-06-13 non-heme iron 2OG setup wires a new mechanism family into the admission engine -- non_heme_iron_2og_dioxygenase (EC 1.14.11 scope, Fe(II)/non-heme metal plus 2-oxoglutarate/succinate/CO2 Rhea participant or Dioxygenase keyword/binding-site/active-site mechanism handle, explicit heme/flavin/peroxide guards) -- expanding the positive fingerprint universe 16 -> 17. The 16fp-era pre-registration's inverse-gate universe is now a strict subset of the live registry, so it is re-frozen against the 17-fingerprint universe before the next OOS hard-negative tranche. NOTE: the OOS inverse gate cannot certify a clean hard-negative until the new positive fingerprint has atlas coverage, so a new OOS tranche stays blocked on coverage until then.

warnings: This artifact re-freezes the next external hard-negative tranche against the current 17-fingerprint universe before candidate selection; it does not import labels.

The 16fp-era pre-registration (v3_external_hard_negative_next_tranche_preregistration_16fp_1025.json) is SUPERSEDED and kept on disk only as the historical record; the 15fp-, 14fp-, 12fp-, and 8fp-era ones remain superseded as well.
External out_of_scope labels remain scoped to ontology_version_at_decision and must be re-audited after any further positive fingerprint expansion.

The OOS inverse gate requires every current fingerprint scored; the new positive fingerprint (non_heme_iron_2og_dioxygenase) has no atlas coverage yet, so the inverse gate reports incomplete-coverage until it is populated.
